verdict.rationale: Kit's broadcast API can create a draft or scheduled broadcast targeted by segment or tag IDs, and drafts can later be updated or deleted. The official Kit MCP gives agents read/write access to broadcasts and segments, and its docs show prompts like "draft a broadcast to my new subscribers" becoming real account actions. A draft left in the account works as a de facto hold for a human to review, but there is no formal approval step. Missing for 10: an explicit human-approval or review workflow (approval gate or permissions that stop an agent from sending), documentation of the draft-to-send handoff, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
